newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury sees no Texas announcement in 96.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury sees no Texas announcement in 96.

text.p: British supermarket group J. Sainsbury Plc said an announcement on the results of talks on pricing of its purchase of Texas Homecare stores from Ladbroke was unlikely before the New Year.
"There is not likely to be an announcement until next year," a spokeswoman for the company said.
Sainsbury paid 290 million stg for the stores to Ladbroke's in January 1995 but the deal was subject to adjustments.
Sainsbury and Ladbroke have been in discussions since then, thought to focus on stock values and debt levels.
A report in the Evening Standard newspaper said an announcement would be made within two weeks.
Sainsbury is steadily converting the Texas Homecare do-it-yourself stores to its own Homebase format.
